integrity: Original theorem proved by explicit forest-lift and PL orbit-complex arguments; established matroid homotopy results cited. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: The PL fixed-locus theorem concerns only designated exchange of equally indexed bipartition classes.
Integral homology of the geometric quotient and integral Z[C2]-lattice extensions are not determined.
The computational verification is exhaustive only for fixed models n<=5 and original chain traces n<=4.
title: Shore-exchange fixed forests and the integral topological trace of balanced bicliques
